definitionEn: Objects and directed morphisms with specified sources, targets, associative composition and a two-sided identity at each object.
definitionZh: 由对象及有指定来源、目标的态射组成，配有结合的合成和各对象上的双侧恒等态射的结构。
example: A poset gives a category with one arrow $x\to y$ exactly when $x\leq y$.
distinction: The arrows are part of the definition: the same objects with different allowed arrows give different categories.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「范畴与态射」，定义 def:category

definitionEn: An arrow with a specified source and target in a category, composable with other arrows when their endpoints match.
definitionZh: 范畴中有指定来源和目标的箭头；端点相接时可与其他态射合成。
example: A linear map $k^2\to k^3$ is a morphism in $\mathbf{Vect}_k$.
distinction: A morphism need not be a set function; an abstract category specifies its own arrows.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「范畴与态射」，def:category 中「态射」及 Hom-集

definitionEn: A morphism $f:X\to Y$ admitting $g:Y\to X$ with $gf=1_X$ and $fg=1_Y$.
definitionZh: 存在态射 g:Y→X 满足 gf=1_X、fg=1_Y 的态射 f:X→Y。
example: $v\mapsto3v$ is an isomorphism in real vector spaces, with inverse $v\mapsto v/3$.
distinction: A bijective continuous map need not be an isomorphism in Top; its inverse must be continuous.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「范畴与态射」，def:category 后的「同构（可逆）」段

definitionEn: The category with the same objects as C, all arrows reversed, and composition performed in the reverse order.
definitionZh: 对象与原范畴相同、态射方向反转、合成顺序相应反转的范畴。
example: The opposite of the poset category $0<1$ has its nonidentity arrow $1\to0$.
distinction: Reversing all arrows does not in general give a category isomorphic to the original.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「范畴与态射」，末尾「反范畴」定义

definitionEn: A category whose objects and all morphisms form sets in the chosen size convention.
definitionZh: 在选定大小约定下，其对象和全部态射均构成集合的范畴。
example: The category of a finite poset is small.
distinction: Smallness is relative to a universe when universes are used; locally small is a weaker condition.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「范畴与态射」，def:U-cat 的「U-小范畴」；固定宇宙约定 con:U-small

definitionEn: A category whose collection of morphisms between each fixed pair of objects is a set.
definitionZh: 任意固定的一对对象之间的态射构成集合的范畴。
example: $\mathbf{Set}$ is locally small although the class of all sets is not a set.
distinction: The Chinese source explicitly uses 局部 U-小范畴; this entry suppresses the fixed universe, as its convention allows.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「范畴与态射」，def:U-cat 后「有些文献将 U-范畴称为局部 U-小范畴」；con:U-small

definitionEn: An assignment of objects and arrows between categories that respects source, target, identities and composition.
definitionZh: 范畴之间同时指定对象和态射的对应，并保持来源、目标、恒等态射和合成的结构。
example: $A\mapsto A\times A$, $f\mapsto f\times f$, is a functor on sets.
distinction: An object assignment alone is insufficient; preservation of identities must also be checked.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子与自然变换」，def:functor；其后「共变函子」

definitionEn: A functor Cᵒᵖ→D, viewed as an assignment from C reversing the direction of arrows.
definitionZh: 从反范畴 Cᵒᵖ 到 D 的函子；视作从 C 出发的对应时，它反转态射方向。
example: For fixed $A$, $\operatorname{Hom}(-,A)$ sends $f:X\to Y$ to precomposition $\operatorname{Hom}(Y,A)\to\operatorname{Hom}(X,A)$.
distinction: Reversing arrows changes the composition law: F(gf)=F(f)F(g).

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子与自然变换」，def:functor 后「反变函子」

definitionEn: A functor inducing an injective map on each hom-set for a fixed pair of source objects.
definitionZh: 对来源范畴任意一对对象，诱导的态射集映射均为单射的函子。
example: The forgetful functor $\mathbf{Vect}_k\to\mathbf{Set}$ is faithful.
distinction: Faithfulness need not distinguish objects; it distinguishes parallel morphisms.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子与自然变换」，紧随 def:functor 的定义，项「忠实」

definitionEn: A functor inducing a surjective map on each hom-set for a fixed pair of source objects.
definitionZh: 对来源范畴任意一对对象，诱导的态射集映射均为满射的函子。
example: The inclusion of abelian groups into groups is full.
distinction: Fullness is about arrows between image objects, not about reaching every target object.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子与自然变换」，紧随 def:functor 的定义，项「全」

definitionEn: A functor F:C→D with a functor G:D→C and natural isomorphisms GF≅1_C and FG≅1_D.
definitionZh: 具有拟逆函子 G 且 GF 与恒等函子、FG 与恒等函子分别自然同构的函子 F:C→D。
example: Finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces are equivalent to the category of natural-number dimensions and matrices.
distinction: Equivalence allows composites naturally isomorphic to identities; isomorphism of categories requires actual inverse functors.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子与自然变换」，def:equivalence 与范畴等价判别；源码中的「范畴等价」

definitionEn: For $F,G:C\to D$, components $\eta_X:F(X)\to G(X)$ satisfying $G(f)\eta_X=\eta_YF(f)$ for every $f:X\to Y$.
definitionZh: 对于 F、G:C→D，由分量 η_X:F(X)→G(X) 组成且对每个 f:X→Y 满足 G(f)η_X=η_YF(f) 的族。
example: The projections $A\times A\to A$ are natural in $A$.
distinction: A collection of correctly typed components need not satisfy naturality.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子与自然变换」，定义「自然变换，或函子间的态射」

definitionEn: A natural transformation all of whose components are isomorphisms, equivalently an invertible morphism in the functor category.
definitionZh: 各分量均为同构的自然变换；等价地，是函子范畴中的可逆态射。
example: $(a,b)\mapsto(b,a)$ naturally identifies $A\times B$ and $B\times A$.
distinction: Pointwise existence of unrelated isomorphisms does not guarantee a natural isomorphism.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子与自然变换」，约定 con:naturaltrans-morphism 中「自然同构」及范畴等价讨论

definitionEn: For small C and locally small D, the category whose objects are functors C→D and whose morphisms are natural transformations.
definitionZh: 当 C 小且 D 局部小时，以 C→D 的函子为对象、自然变换为态射、逐分量合成为态射合成的范畴。
example: For a discrete two-object $C$, $[C,\mathbf{Set}]$ is the category of pairs of sets.
distinction: The smallness of C ensures transformation collections are sets in this formulation.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「函子范畴」，定义「函子范畴」及其后大小说明

definitionEn: A set-valued functor naturally isomorphic to Hom(-,A) in the contravariant case, or Hom(A,-) in the covariant case.
definitionZh: 反变情形自然同构于 Hom(-,A)、或共变情形自然同构于 Hom(A,-) 的集合值函子。
example: On sets, $B\mapsto B^A$ is represented covariantly by $A$.
distinction: A family of bijections without naturality is not a representation.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「可表函子」，定义 def:representable-functor

definitionEn: For small $C$, presheaf $P$, and $A\in C$, evaluation at $1_A$ gives $\operatorname{Nat}(\operatorname{Hom}(-,A),P)\cong P(A)$ naturally.
definitionZh: 对于小范畴 C、预层 P 和对象 A，在 1_A 处取值给出 Nat(Hom(-,A),P) 与 P(A) 的自然双射。
example: For the poset $0<1<2$ and constant presheaf $\{0,1\}$, exactly two transformations $h_1\to P$ exist.
distinction: The direction of the hom-functor must match the variance of P.

definitionSources.label: Tom Leinster — Basic Category Theory (author arXiv edition)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「可表函子」，定理 prop:Yoneda-lemma 与「米田引理」段

definitionEn: A characterization of specified object-and-map data by a unique factorization for every competing compatible object-and-map datum.
definitionZh: 用任意其他相容对象及映射资料的唯一分解，刻画指定对象及映射资料的性质。
example: Maps $X\to A\times B$ correspond uniquely to pairs of maps $X\to A$ and $X\to B$.
distinction: The structure maps belong to the data; uniqueness normally means up to a unique compatible isomorphism.

definitionSources.label: Tom Leinster — Basic Category Theory (author arXiv edition)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「泛性质」，开头及始终对象之后的「泛性质」段

definitionEn: For a small diagram D:J→C, a cone through which every other cone factors by a unique vertex map respecting all legs.
definitionZh: 对于小图表 D:J→C，一个锥使任意其他锥都通过唯一的顶点态射分解，并保持所有锥边。
example: A pullback of $2a$ and $3b$ on integers is $\{(3k,2k):k\in\mathbb Z\}$.
distinction: Li’s table uses 极限 for lim and 余极限 for colim; inverse limit may also denote a particular inverse-system shape.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)
definitionSources.locator: §3.1, cone and limit definitions; §3.2 Limits in the Category of Sets

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「极限」，def:limit 后术语对照表中的「极限 (lim)」

definitionEn: For a small diagram, a cocone from which every compatible cocone factors by a unique map of vertices respecting all legs.
definitionZh: 对于小图表，一个余锥使任意其他相容余锥都由它经唯一的顶点态射分解，并保持所有余锥边。
example: The colimit in sets of $\{0\}\subset\{0,1\}\subset\cdots$ is $\mathbb N$.
distinction: Colimits reverse the universal arrow direction; a categorical colimit is not generally a union.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)
definitionSources.locator: §3.1, Definition 3.1.23; §3.2 Limits in the Category of Sets

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「极限」，def:limit 后术语对照表中的「余极限 (colim)」

definitionEn: An object T receiving exactly one morphism X→T from every object X of its category.
definitionZh: 从范畴任意对象 X 出发，到它的态射恰有一个的对象 T。
example: Any singleton is terminal in $\mathbf{Set}$.
distinction: A one-point space is terminal in Top; the empty set is initial in Set, not terminal.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「泛性质」，定义 def:universal-objects 中「终对象」

definitionEn: An object I having exactly one morphism I→X to every object X of its category.
definitionZh: 到范畴任意对象 X 的态射恰有一个的对象 I。
example: $\emptyset$ is initial in $\mathbf{Set}$.
distinction: Initial does not mean a least element unless the category is a poset category.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「泛性质」，定义 def:universal-objects 中「始对象」

definitionEn: Objects P with projections to a specified family such that every matching family of maps from any X arises uniquely from a map X→P.
definitionZh: 配有到指定对象族的投影的对象 P，使从任意 X 出发的相应映射族都唯一来自 X→P 的态射。
example: The product of sets $\{2\}$ and $\{5,7\}$ has two ordered pairs.
distinction: The product includes its projections; in a poset it is a greatest lower bound.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「极限」，有限极限讨论，积与余积的第一项

definitionEn: An object with maps from a specified family such that each family of maps into any Y extends uniquely to a map from that object to Y.
definitionZh: 配有从指定对象族进入的态射的对象，使到任意 Y 的对应态射族都唯一延拓为从该对象到 Y 的态射。
example: $\{2\}\sqcup\{2\}$ is a two-element coproduct in sets.
distinction: Ordinary union of overlapping sets fails to retain independent maps out of each component.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「极限」，有限极限讨论，积与余积的第一项「余积」

definitionEn: For A→C←B, an object P with maps to A and B making the square commute and universal among such commuting pairs.
definitionZh: 对于 A→C←B，带有到 A、B 的态射、使相应方块交换，且对所有这种交换态射对具有唯一分解性质的对象。
example: For inclusions $A,B\subseteq C$, their pullback in sets is $A\cap B$.
distinction: A commuting square need not be a pullback; the universal property is additional.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「完备性」，def:completeness 后「纤维积及其对偶版本」定义第一项；非 Hom 函子的同名拉回

definitionEn: For parallel f,g:A→B, a map e:E→A with fe=ge universal among maps with that equality.
definitionZh: 对于平行态射 f、g:A→B，满足 fe=ge 且对所有满足同样等式的映射具有唯一分解性质的态射 e:E→A。
example: The equalizer of $n\mapsto n^2$ and $n\mapsto n$ on $\mathbb Z$ is $\{0,1\}\hookrightarrow\mathbb Z$.
distinction: A kernel is a special equalizer in a pointed setting; arbitrary equalizers need not involve zero maps.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「极限」，平行箭头的极限项：「等化子 或差核」

definitionEn: Functors F:C→D and G:D→C together with bijections Hom_D(FX,Y)≅Hom_C(X,GY) natural in X and Y.
definitionZh: 函子 F:C→D、G:D→C 连同在 X、Y 两变元中自然的双射 Hom_D(FX,Y)≅Hom_C(X,GY)。
example: The free $k$-vector-space functor is left adjoint to the underlying-set functor.
distinction: Adjoint functors need not be inverse equivalences; the hom-set correspondence is the requirement.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「伴随函子」，定义 def:adjunction-pair「伴随对」

definitionEn: For $F\dashv G$, the natural transformation $\eta:1_C\Rightarrow GF$ whose component corresponds to $1_{FX}$ under the adjunction bijection.
definitionZh: 对于 F⊣G，由伴随双射把 1_FX 对应到 η_X:X→GFX 而组成的自然变换 η:1_C⇒GF。
example: For free vector spaces, $\eta_S(s)=e_s$.
distinction: Unit here belongs to an adjunction; it is not the multiplicative identity of a ring.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「伴随函子」，定义 def:adjunction-unit-counit「单位」

definitionEn: For $F\dashv G$, the natural transformation $\varepsilon:FG\Rightarrow1_D$ whose component corresponds to $1_{GY}$ under the inverse adjunction bijection.
definitionZh: 对于 F⊣G，由伴随双射的逆把 1_GY 对应到 ε_Y:FGY→Y 而组成的自然变换 ε:FG⇒1_D。
example: For free vector spaces, $\varepsilon_V(\sum a_i e_{v_i})=\sum a_i v_i$.
distinction: The counit and unit have different domains; triangle identities do not make their components literal inverses.

definitionSources.label: Emily Riehl — Category Theory in Context (current second-edition draft)

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「伴随函子」，定义 def:adjunction-unit-counit「余单位」

definitionEn: A category in which every morphism is invertible.
definitionZh: 每个态射都可逆的范畴。
example: A group viewed as a one-object category is a groupoid.
distinction: A groupoid may have many objects; higher groupoids retain higher homotopies beyond an ordinary groupoid.

definitionSources.label: Jacob Lurie — Higher Topos Theory (author IAS PDF)
definitionSources.locator: §1.1.1, discussion of groupoids and higher groupoids

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第2章，「范畴与态射」，定义「广群 (groupoid)」

definitionEn: A categorical structure with higher morphisms and coherent composition; the scoped (∞,1) model here is a simplicial set admitting fillers for every inner horn.
definitionZh: 具有高阶态射和相容合成资料的范畴结构；本条限定的 (∞,1) 模型是每个内角都可填充的单纯集合。
example: The nerve of an ordinary category and every Kan complex give $(\infty,1)$-category examples.
distinction: Higher category is broader than (∞,1)-category; this entry fixes a model instead of claiming all higher theories share one definition.

definitionSources.label: Jacob Lurie — Higher Topos Theory (author IAS PDF)

translationSources.label: 徐斐（汕头大学）— 教师页面
translationSources.locator: 「研究介绍」末段：「高阶范畴理论」；仅支持中文名称的使用
